source_refs.title: If your iPhone or iPad gets too hot or too cold - Apple Support
source_refs.section: If a temperature warning screen appears
source_refs.applicability: iPhone; the page says iOS and iPadOS devices have built-in protections to prevent overheating; the warning screen appears when the device exceeds a certain temperature threshold
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If your device exceeds a certain temperature threshold, it will present a temperature warning screen similar to this:
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone, if a temperature warning screen appears: 1. Turn off your device. 2. Move your device to a cooler environment (away from direct sunlight). 3. Allow your device to cool down. An iPhone showing this message might still be able to make emergency calls.
